# Touch Domain

> Touch Domain is a South African digital studio for small and growing businesses (SMEs). One team handles brand identity, web design, digital content, website hosting, email hosting, and custom app development — from initial concept through launch, and ongoing afterward. Based in South Africa, serving South African SMEs.

## About

Most agencies specialize in one thing — a logo, a website, or social content — and hand it off. Touch Domain does brand, build, content, hosting, and app development together, as one coherent identity, with the same team supporting a client after launch rather than disappearing once the invoice is paid.

- Website: https://www.touchdomain.co.za
- Email: info@touchdomain.co.za
- Phone: 081 327 6153
- Social: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn — all linked from the site footer

## Services

Full package details and current pricing: https://www.touchdomain.co.za/services

### Brand Identity
- Launchpad — R3,500 — logo design, logo variations, colour palette, typography, basic brand board, essential digital assets
- Elevate & Expand — R7,500 — adds a comprehensive brand style guide, full stationery suite, social media kit, iconography, marketing collateral
- Pinnacle Identity — R14,000 — adds a brand strategy workshop, extensive imagery guidelines, custom graphic elements, corporate presentation template, brand voice guidelines

### Web Design
- Digital Launchpad — R6,500 — custom website design, responsive development, initial SEO setup, contact form
- Online Accelerator — R14,500 — up to 10 pages, advanced UI/UX, basic e-commerce, CMS setup, blog integration
- Digital Dominator — from R28,000 — 15+ pages, advanced e-commerce, API integrations, performance optimization, advanced SEO

### Digital Content
- Storyteller Starter — R4,000 — social media graphics, animated GIFs, digital ad banners, image curation
- Impact Maximizer — R8,500 — content calendar, social video, infographic design, custom iconography
- Narrative Designer — R15,000 — full content strategy, explainer video, interactive content, motion graphics, branded templates

### Website Hosting (billed monthly, cancel any time)
- Foundation — R89/month — 2GB SSD, 5 email accounts, free SSL, free daily backups
- Growth — R159/month — 5GB SSD, 15 email accounts
- Priority — R249/month — 10GB SSD, 25 email accounts, priority support

### Email Hosting (no website required, billed monthly)
- Email Starter — R35/month — 5 mailboxes, 2GB each
- Email Team — R65/month — 15 mailboxes, 5GB each
- Email Business — R99/month — 30 mailboxes, 10GB each, priority support

### App Development
- App Essentials — R14,500 — installable, offline-ready Progressive Web App
- App Growth — from R32,000 — custom web app with user accounts, database-backed dashboard, one core workflow
- App Priority — from R55,000 — multi-user roles, payment integration, admin dashboard, third-party API integrations
